ImageDescription.value: Santa Cruz Cathedral Basilica is a famous historic church located in Fort Kochi, Kerala. It was originally built by the Portuguese in 1505 and later rebuilt in the Gothic style. The church is known for its beautiful architecture, frescoes and colourful stained-glass windows. It is one of the eight Basilicas in India and an important religious and tourist attraction.  The basilica reflects the rich Portuguese and Christian heritage of Kochi.
